title: Deviation Artifact Schema
description: Schema for static-analysis / coding-guideline deviation records mined from in-source suppression annotations, extending artifact-base.schema.json. A deviation record is an observed, in-source justified deviation from a coding-guideline rule. It is NOT evidence of conformance, tool qualification, or a completed ISO 26262 / ASPICE assessment.

guideline_id.description: Coding-guideline / rule-set identifier the deviation is taken against, as written in the source annotation

rule_reference.description: Rule or directive number exactly as written in the source annotation (e.g. 'Directive-4.1', '1.2', '20.10'). The rule-set prefix is carried by guideline_id and tool_reference.annotation, not repeated here: only the bare form is accepted, so a single site cannot be written two ways. Proprietary rule text is not reproduced.

rule_category.description: Category label derived strictly from the source annotation token: 'MisraC2012Directive-x.y' -> advisory_directive, 'MisraC2012-x.y' -> rule. This is a corpus-local label and is NOT a claim about the proprietary MISRA severity classification. The derivation is machine-enforced by the allOf if/then blocks below: rule_reference must carry the 'Directive-' prefix if and only if rule_category is advisory_directive.

deviation_rationale.description: Verbatim developer rationale text as written in the in-source suppression annotation (comment markers stripped, internal line breaks flattened)

deviation_type.description: Corpus-local classification of the engineering reason for the deviation, derived from the recorded rationale

affected_file.description: Repository-relative path of the file carrying the suppression annotation

affected_symbol.description: Enclosing C function, macro, object or 'module level' scope that the suppression annotation encloses

affected_lines.description: One or more line ranges in the pinned source, from the Disable/Next annotation to the matching Enable annotation (comma separated)

review_disposition.description: What the pinned source evidences about governance of this deviation. 'recorded_inline_no_governance_evidence' = rationale present in source but no approval/deviance-log artifact found in the repository. 'recorded_inline_ambiguous_rule_scope' = the Disable and matching Enable annotations name different rule sets for the same region.

review_disposition_note.description: Evidence trail for the review_disposition value, including what governance artifact was searched for and not found

reanalysis_justification.description: Why the deviation must be re-analysed (next static-analysis run, tool change, compiler/ABI change, rule-set revision, or refactor of the affected construct)

suppression_form.description: Axivion annotation form used in the source

suppression_scope.description: Scope the suppressed check applies to in the source

tool.description: Static-analysis tool named by the annotation family

check_family.description: Axivion check family as written in the source. Machine-enforced against tool_reference.annotation by the allOf if/then block below: the family suffix must be the same token the annotation uses.

annotation.description: Full check identifier as written in the source, e.g. 'MisraC2012Directive-4.1' or 'MisraC2012-1.2'. The MisraC2012 annotation form is enforced so a non-MISRA identifier cannot be recorded as this record's own check; co-located non-MISRA families belong in co_located_non_misra_checks.

co_located_non_misra_checks.description: Other Axivion check families suppressed on the same line or in the same annotation block, outside the MISRA rule set

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim source excerpt carrying the annotation, so a reviewer can locate and check the record against the pinned source

rule_text_reproduced.description: Always false. MISRA C:2012 rule text is proprietary and is not reproduced in this corpus.

rule_severity_asserted.description: Always false. No claim is made about the proprietary MISRA severity/classification of the referenced rule.

conformance_claimed.description: Always false. The record documents an observed deviation; it does not assert MISRA conformance.

status.description: Normative verification status. Rule numbers are reproduced exactly as written in the source comment only.

deviations.description: Complete enumeration of every suppressed annotation site on this symbol, including the primary rule repeated in the top-level typed fields. Each entry names its own site by affected_lines; two entries may carry the same rule_reference when they are distinct sites of the same rule (for example two Disable annotations of one rule inside a single block, or a block site plus an out-of-query 'Next Codeline' site on the same symbol). Each entry repeats the typed shape so no information is lost to prose.

design_artifact_id.description: as_is software design artifact that owns the affected code, or null when the as_is profile has no design artifact for it. The value is bound to coverage_status by the allOf if/then block below: a declared coverage_status requires a design-artifact id, and a declared gap requires null.

note.description: Impact note supported by the observed source, stated as an observation rather than an assessment

project_process_evidence.description: The project's own written statements that the deviation is taken against, quoted from the pinned documentation

scope_note.description: Statement of what this record set does and does not cover. Any count it states must be derivable by re-running corpus_scope.query against the pinned source.

allOf.$comment: The if/then/else blocks above constrain existing field pairs only. This subschema still admits any other property a record carries, so those constraints close specific gaps without narrowing the record shape.

rule_reference.description: Bare form only, matching the top-level rule_reference: the rule-set prefix is not repeated here, so the same site cannot be written two ways.

rule_category.description: Derived from rule_reference exactly as at the top level: the 'Directive-' prefix is present if and only if this is advisory_directive.
